snippet.title: Field of Heroes - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam at https://store.steampowered.com/app/1267290/Field_of_Heroes/

Field of Heroes is a 5v5 PvPvE real-time online spectacle that mixes competitive sports and visceral combat -- but with orcs. A LOT of orcs. And it's coming soon to your PC on Steam and Steam Deck!

Watch us develop the game LIVE on Twitch: https://twitch.tv/gamieon
Like us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/playfieldofheroes/
Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/FieldOfHeroes
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fieldofheroes/
Follow us on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@field.of.heroes
